notes.title: SLIDING HERO SLIDES INTO THE SOKOBAN FEST
notes.content:
Hello sliders!

Silent Chicken team here.

To celebrate our participation in the STEAM Box-Pushing Fest (so excited!), we are releasing a major Demo update for Sliding Hero.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45014346/934cca6b6b33ecb9357e5c9310f24e3e886f0286.png[/img]

[h2]QOL[/h2]

[h3]Rebinding is now live![/h3]
You can now slide and solve puzzles the way you want: just go over the settings, and choose your own controls!

[h3]No more deadly holes[/h3]
The jumping mechanics were too punitive, so to address the community feedback, we changed the behaviour of the holes in the ground: falling into a hole will now decrease Luca's hearts by one and respawn him right at the room entrance. After depleting all the hearts, Luca will respawn at the latest safe area.

[h3]New tutorial puzzles[/h3]
To improve the demo pacing and better explain certain game mechanics, we added a bunch of mildly challenging puzzles at the start, before reaching the hedge maze area.

[h3]New artworks[/h3]
The bestiary artworks have been updated to the final version.

[h2]BUG Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Localization[/h3]
We solved several bugs related to the Korean, Japanese, and Chinese translations, which prevented specific characters from being shown.

[h3]Prompts[/h3]
Solved an issue not displaying the correct prompts depending on the device connected. Now fully support Xbox, Ps3, Ps4 and Ps5 controllers.

[h2]DISCLAIMER[/h2]

Because of the new rooms, some previous save states may not be working correctly.

Thanks a lot, and keep on sliding!

notes.title: SLIDING HERO SPEEDRUN CONTEST
notes.content:
Hello Sliders, Silent Chicken dev here! 🐔

We are running a Speedrun contest to celebrate the participation in the Steam Next Fest.

Participate for a chance to win a free copy of the game!


[h2]SPEEDRUN CONTEST[/h2]
[h3]Win a free copy of Sliding Hero*[/h3]
*The 10 fastest speedruns posted on our channels will win a copy of the game.

Step 1: Play the demo
Step 2: Take a screenshot of your final stats
Step 3: Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/F8qkNNEuVj

Step 4: Share your screenshot
Step 5: Profit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45014346/a257a94c1fbcc17103bbc2a69abef71343ec6d9b.png[/img]

Winners will be announced after the end of Steam Next Fest, Tuesday, March 4, 2025, 10 am PST
Submission deadline: Monday, March 3, 2025, 10 am PST


Keep on sliding!

notes.title: Sliding Hero demo version 0.0.31 now available
notes.content:
An update for Sliding Hero's is out now, with several bug fixes and QOL improvements.

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
Made menu easier to navigate

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented loading from a previous save state.
[*] Fixed certain enemies and equipment not behaving correctly upon loading a save state.
[*] Fixed audio issues that prevented the correct sound from playing in certain places.
[/list]

Have fun, and let us know what you think of the demo - and report any bugs - in Sliding Hero's community: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2966300/discussions/

notes.title: SLIDING HERO IS PART OF THE CONVERGENCE SHOWCASE!
notes.content:
We slid it again, and are part of a new showcase, side by side with some exciting new games and announcements.

Discover more about the game at 9 PM GMT +1 [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abLORQCxCzo]here[/url] and check out the selection [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45098973/sale/convergence-games-showcase-2024]here[/url].

We are out with Sliding Hero’s biggest demo update to celebrate the occasion!

[h2]Explore a new section of the gardens[/h2]

A previously locked area of the garden is now mysteriously open. Where will it lead? Which challenges will it hide? What mysteries? Find it out now.

[h2]Sliding Hero goes polyglot![/h2]

Enjoy the tale of Luca Sicomoro in a selection of languages as part of the idioms update series. All the dialogues and menu entries are now translated, and the UI will be tackled next.

[h2]How fast can you slide?[/h2]

Upon finishing the demo, you can now discover your performance: the number of moves, time to finish the demo, number of deaths, and so on. Can you beat the record?

Let us know what you think of the new Demo in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2966300]Steam Community[/url], and share your stats!

notes.title: SLIDING HERO SLIDES INTO THE SIX ONE INDIE SHOWCASE
notes.content:
[h2]Mama, we are famous![/h2]
After skating, skidding, and drifting and slipping around, Sliding Hero is getting noticed!

We are really proud to be part of this year's [url=https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase]Six One Indie[/url] showcase, side by side with amazing indie gems and legendary developers: find us on IGN  (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iioUfAQ44Zo) and in the  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45119430/sale/SOISFall2024]Six One Indie Fest[/url] from the 19th to the 23rd.

[h2]NEW DEMO OUT![/h2]
To celebrate the occasion, we are out with a new Demo version with a better-optimized UI, bestiary and lore journal, player performance tracking and several bug fixes.


Let us know what you think of the new Demo in our Steam Community: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2966300

notes.title: Sliding Hero's demo v0.0.26 is live!
notes.content:
A new version of the Sliding Hero's demo is live now, with a hotfix for the final battle known bug.

[h1]NEW IN VERSION 0.0.26[/h1]

Now you can defeat [spoiler]Locke[/spoiler] without the game freezing and forcing you to quit and reload.

Keep on sliding, heroes!
